assertions.text: Derives {owner}/{repo} from the resolved PR's url field before checking anything else
Resolves origin's actual destination via git remote get-url origin piped through the documented sed -E strip-prefix/strip-.git command
Compares the resolved {owner}/{repo} against origin's actual destination and detects the mismatch
Stops and reports the bypass was not attested because gh pr view resolved a different repository than origin, naming GH_REPO/gh repo set-default as the likely cause
States plainly that the push already succeeded and is unaffected -- only the attestation is skipped
Never proceeds to the shared protocol's steps 1-5 on the mismatched PR, and never treats the coincidentally-passing isCrossRepository/headRefOid checks as sufficient on their own
